audience: Director who owns a service · head of a ministry ICT unit · programme lead

videos.title: What to require from a supplier
videos.message: The twelve documents are deliverables you name in the contract, each accepted by a named person.

videos.title: When something changes, correct the document that owns the fact
videos.message: A change goes up to its source and everything below is produced again.

videos.title: Read where the work stands from the work
videos.message: Progress is a report the programs produce from the documents, never a figure someone remembers.

videos.title: The AI assistant at every step, and the person who rules
videos.message: The assistant drafts each document; a person rules on every proposal and every gap keeps its name.

videos.title: The next service on the same foundation
videos.message: The second service, a digital credential, reuses what the first one built and proved.

videos.title: Carry the method to another sector
videos.message: The method holds no sector's content; another sector brings its own catalogue and its own records.

videos.title: Before you rely on it: what the method does not claim
videos.message: The method states its own limits, and a manager reads them before relying on it.
